payload.name: pc-classify-value
payload.description: Classify an optional raw value while preserving the distinction between missing and null. Returns {state:"missing",value:null} for absent inputs, {state:"null",value:null} for an explicit null, {state:"value",value:original} for an exact integer in 0..10 inclusive (not bool/float), and {state:"invalid",value:null} for any other value. No defaults, coercion, exceptions, imports, host or I/O. Unapproved offline-design draft; no UUID, version, association or approval.
